desc: Get your AR build one step closer to complete with the Colt’s Manufacturing Lower Parts Kit for AR15/M4 platforms. Precision-engineered by one of the most trusted names in firearms, this kit includes the essential components you need for dependable performance and smooth function. Whether you're refreshing an old lower, replacing worn parts, or completing a new build, Colt's high-quality parts offer mil-spec reliability backed by legendary craftsmanship.
